verdict.rationale: Parahelp supports headless operation in several ways. The changelog says you can run the Internal Agent from your own tools via the API with auto-approve, so it acts without waiting for human approval. The Customer Agent can take requests through the API instead of a ticketing system. Automations run on schedules or triggers such as a GitHub PR merging. Missing for 10: a CLI or CI-runner integration (e.g. a GitHub Action), a published API reference or OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), documented API auth for headless use, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
